readout_other: morphine conditioned place preference; H&E; anti-MAP2, anti-JNK1 and caspase-3 immunostaining; Fluoro-Jade C
direction_notes: Place preference for the morphine-paired side rose significantly in sham rats but not in sonicated rats; LIFU did not significantly reduce preference.
safety_notes: Three US-group rats and one saline rat died during anaesthesia. Histology (H&E, MAP2, JNK1, Fluoro-Jade C) showed no tissue damage in the nucleus accumbens.

timing.protocol_description: LIFU stimulation was given for 10 min once a day for 10 days, under 1.5% isoflurane, ten minutes before morphine administration; pulse timing, PRF and duty cycle are not given in the text.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Dividing the rats into two groups: sonication group (9 for LIFU and 9 for sham) and physiologic saline group S NPP M/S
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Before morphine administrations, rats in US group and sham group received isoflurane inhaler anaesthetic (1.5%) once a day for 10 days
